cloudgate_fixture.how: Planned offline on 2026-11-10 by `tofu plan -refresh=false` with the pinned OpenTofu 1.13.1 and hashicorp/google 8.8.0 from the generated definition, with no state and no Google call, in the stored files' sample ids (cloud_1, env_1, project example-project-123, region europe-west1), then `tofu show -json`. A Compose stack's Stack VM (analytics, svc_compose_1, state_compose_1) at medium, e2-small, on the applied network's names, with two Domains' ports, 3000 and 8080 (#1371): its instance group, a health check and a backend service per port, and the load balancer's firewall rule. The image is passed as the recorded one.

metadata.user-data:
#cloud-config
package_update: true
packages:
  - ca-certificates
  - curl
  - unattended-upgrades
write_files:
  - path: /usr/local/sbin/cloudgate-data-disk
    permissions: '0755'
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail
      root="$(lsblk -no PKNAME "$(findmnt -no SOURCE /)")"
      disk=""
      for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
        for candidate in $(lsblk -dno NAME,TYPE | awk '$2 == "disk" {print $1}'); do
          if [ "$candidate" != "$root" ] && [ -z "$(lsblk -no MOUNTPOINT "/dev/$candidate" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then
            disk="/dev/$candidate"
            break 2
          fi
        done
        sleep 5
      done
      if [ -z "$disk" ]; then
        echo "cloudgate: no data disk was attached" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      if ! blkid "$disk" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        mkfs.ext4 -L cloudgate-data "$disk"
      fi
      uuid="$(blkid -s UUID -o value "$disk")"
      mkdir -p /var/lib/docker/volumes
      if ! grep -q "$uuid" /etc/fstab; then
        echo "UUID=$uuid /var/lib/docker/volumes ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2" >> /etc/fstab
      fi
      mount -a
  - path: /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists "1";
      APT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade "1";
  - path: /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/52cloudgate-unattended-upgrades
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      Unattended-Upgrade::Automatic-Reboot "false";
runcmd:
  - /usr/local/sbin/cloudgate-data-disk
  - install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
  - curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
  - chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
  - echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu noble stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list
  - apt-get update
  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker-ce=5:29.9.2-1~ubuntu.24.04~noble docker-ce-cli=5:29.9.2-1~ubuntu.24.04~noble containerd.io docker-compose-plugin=5.6.1-1~ubuntu.24.04~noble
  - apt-mark hold docker-ce docker-ce-cli docker-compose-plugin
  - systemctl enable --now docker
  - docker network inspect cloudgate-network >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create cloudgate-network
